title: Towards Feasible Counterfactual Explanations: A Taxonomy Guided Template-based NLG Method

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying race and ethnicity as 'Immutable Sensitive' features within a Feature Actionability Taxonomy (FAT) to prevent the natural language generation model from producing offensive or biased counterfactual suggestions.

Conducting a user study to evaluate the sensitivity and ethical acceptability of counterfactual explanations, specifically capturing and analyzing qualitative user feedback regarding algorithmic suggestions to change a person's sex.

Evaluating user perceptions using Likert-scale ratings and thematic analysis to identify whether counterfactual recommendations suggesting an alteration of a user's age are viewed as discriminatory or unethical.

Using qualitative thematic analysis on user responses to assess the discriminatory impact and acceptability of counterfactual explanations that suggest changing immutable medical conditions (e.g., subtype of thalassemia).
